# SecInterp Agent Configuration — Compatibility Pointer

The canonical agent configuration now lives in the **root `AGENTS.md`**
(see [`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)), which opencode loads automatically.

Role definitions (`@architect`, `@qa_engineer`, `@auditor`), the skills
matrix, and the workflows table are all maintained there — in one place.

**Do not edit this file.** It is kept only so legacy references
(`file://./AGENTS.md`) and historical documentation continue to resolve.
